headlines.summary_en: International crude opened lower Monday, with Brent falling over 7% at one point, breaking below $90, while Nasdaq futures rose over 1%. US-Iran mutual strikes paused: Iran's military said Sunday the US halted strikes for two consecutive nights, and Iran suspended retaliatory strikes. Red Sea tensions heat up: Yemen's Houthis attacked Saudi Red Sea port oil facilities twice in one day Saturday, with Saudi airstrikes in response. Former CSRC Vice Chairman Fang Xinghai is under investigation. Wang Yi met Iran's Foreign Minister Araghchi, saying China continues to support mediation efforts by Pakistan and others, urging early resumption of dialogue and proper handling of the Hormuz Strait issue. China's MOFCOM placed 14 EU entities on an export control list. MOF and STA: individual property placed in offshore trusts and trust income during the period must pay individual income tax. The 'Two Supremes' revised judicial interpretations to intensify punishment for insider trading and leaking inside information.

headlines.summary: 金十数据7月27日讯，文章称，7月22日，美国白宫科技政策办公室主任迈克尔·克拉齐奥斯突然在社交媒体上宣称，中国AI企业“月之暗面”通过蒸馏美国Anthropic公司的Fable开发Kimi K3大模型。仅仅几个小时后，美国财政部长斯科特·贝森特发文威胁，要用制裁和“实体清单”来应对中国企业的蒸馏。中国在AI领域的发展与成就全球有目共睹。美国部分政客身处关乎美国科技发展的关键职位，应当做内行人，不应老说外行话，信口开河地污蔑中国大模型靠蒸馏，这样只能让自己看起来很业余。

headlines.title: 【A股温度计】情绪指标统计：上周五成交量刷新4月以来新低，首破两万亿
headlines.summary:
1、沪深两市7月24日总成交量下降至1.94万亿，明显低于20日均线2.86万亿。
2、7月24日衡量A股杠杆水平的融资买入额占A股流动市值之比为9.87%，继续围绕着10%大幅波动。
--------
注：1、两市成交量反映了各大机构、游资、广大散户对A股看法，高于均线代表总成交量升高，市场情绪偏乐观，低于均线代表总成交量下降，市场情绪降温。
2、2015年以来，A股杠杆水平大部分时候维持在6%-10%，杠杆率超过10%意味着市场活跃度较高，可能接近或者处于牛市。达到15%以上意味着市场有过热风险，需要警惕风险。
